(()=>{
 'use strict';const C=window.VeredaCommerce,S=window.VeredaStudio,$=s=>document.querySelector(s),esc=S.esc,sel=$('#sector'),form=$('#item-editor');const asked=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('setor');if(C.sectors.includes(asked))sel.value=asked;let items=[],editing=null;
 const routes={petshop:'petshop/companhia.html',pizzaria:'pizzaria/forno.html',salao:'salao/ritual.html'};
 function resetEditor(){editing=null;form.reset();form.elements.sku.readOnly=false;form.elements.duracao_min.value=sel.value==='salao'?'60':'0';$('#editor-heading').textContent='Adicionar um item.';$('#edit-status').textContent='';}
 function draw(){items=C.load(sel.value);document.body.className=sel.value;$('#open-shop').href=routes[sel.value];$('#campaign-link').href='campanhas.html?nicho='+sel.value;$('#catalog-rows').innerHTML=items.map(p=>`<tr><td><strong>${esc(p.nome)}</strong><br>${esc(p.sku)} / ${esc(p.categoria)}</td><td>${C.money(p.preco_centavos)}<br>${p.ativo?'Ativo':'Pausado'} · ${sel.value==='salao'?p.duracao_min+' min':p.estoque+' un.'}</td><td><button data-edit="${esc(p.sku)}">Editar</button></td></tr>`).join('');drawRequests();}
 function readRequests(){try{const r=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('vereda-requests-'+sel.value)||'[]');return Array.isArray(r)?r:[];}catch{return [];}}
 function drawRequests(){const rows=readRequests(),statuses=sel.value==='salao'?['Aguardando confirmação','Confirmado na simulação','Concluído','Cancelado']:['Aguardando confirmação','Em preparação','Saiu para entrega','Pronto para retirada','Concluído','Cancelado'];$('#requests').innerHTML=rows.map(r=>`<article class="request-card"><h3>${esc(r.id)} <span class="badge">DEMONSTRAÇÃO</span></h3><p>${r.service?esc(r.service)+' · '+esc(r.data)+' · '+String(Math.floor(r.inicio_min/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(r.inicio_min%60).padStart(2,'0'):esc((r.items||r.sabores||[]).map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:x.nome).join(' / '))} · ${C.money(r.total_centavos||0)}</p><label>Status local<select data-status="${esc(r.id)}">${statuses.map(s=>`<option ${s===r.status?'selected':''}>${s}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></article>`).join('')||'<p>Nenhuma solicitação preparada nesta sessão.</p>';}
 sel.addEventListener('change',()=>{history.replaceState(null,'','?setor='+sel.value);$('#catalog-status').textContent='';resetEditor();draw();});$('#new-item').addEventListener('click',resetEditor);
 $('#catalog-rows').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-edit]');if(!b)return;const p=items.find(x=>x.sku===b.dataset.edit);if(!p)return;editing=p.sku;for(const k of ['sku','nome','categoria','estoque','especie','duracao_min','detalhe','ativo'])form.elements[k].value=String(p[k]);form.elements.price.value=(p.preco_centavos/100).toFixed(2);form.elements.sku.readOnly=true;$('#editor-heading').textContent='Editar item.';form.elements.nome.focus();});
 form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const r=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)),price=Number(r.price);if(!Number.isFinite(price)||price<0)throw Error('Informe um preço válido.');const record={...r,preco_centavos:Math.round(price*100)},next=editing?items.map(p=>p.sku===editing?record:p):[...items,record];C.save(sel.value,next);resetEditor();draw();$('#edit-status').textContent='Catálogo atualizado neste navegador. Recarregue a vitrine para ver a alteração.';}catch(e){$('#edit-status').textContent=e.message;}});
 $('#import-catalog').addEventListener('change',async e=>{try{const file=e.target.files?.[0];if(!file)return;if(file.size>250000)throw Error('Use um arquivo de até 250 KB.');const text=await file.text(),parsed=file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')?C.parseCSV(text):JSON.parse(text),data=C.validate(parsed,sel.value);C.save(sel.value,data);resetEditor();draw();$('#catalog-status').textContent=`${data.length} itens importados. Base local substituída após validação integral.`;}catch(err){$('#catalog-status').textContent='Importação recusada: '+err.message;}finally{e.target.value='';}});
 $('#export-json').addEventListener('click',()=>C.download('catalogo-'+sel.value+'.json',items));$('#export-csv').addEventListener('click',()=>{const heads=['sku','nome','categoria','preco_centavos','ativo','estoque','detalhe','especie','duracao_min'];C.download('catalogo-'+sel.value+'.csv','\uFEFF'+[heads,...items.map(p=>heads.map(h=>p[h]))].map(r=>r.map(S.csvCell).join(';')).join('\r\n'),'text/csv;charset=utf-8');});
 $('#restore-catalog').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!confirm('Restaurar somente o catálogo fictício deste setor neste navegador?'))return;try{C.save(sel.value,C.seed[sel.value]);resetEditor();draw();$('#catalog-status').textContent='Catálogo demonstrativo restaurado.';}catch(e){$('#catalog-status').textContent=e.message;}});
 $('#refresh-requests').addEventListener('click',drawRequests);$('#export-requests').addEventListener('click',()=>C.download('solicitacoes-demo-'+sel.value+'.json',readRequests()));$('#requests').addEventListener('change',e=>{const el=e.target.closest('[data-status]');if(!el)return;const rows=readRequests(),r=rows.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.status);if(!r)return;r.status=el.value;sessionStorage.setItem('vereda-requests-'+sel.value,JSON.stringify(rows));drawRequests();});window.addEventListener('storage',draw);resetEditor();draw();
})();
